player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Rypcord''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in November 2001.
description: I hastily built this deck before the Episode 1 tournament today. I won both times with this, and James Leiser won once with it.
cards: posted: An Unusual Amount of Fear
posted: Brisky Morning Munchen + Brisky Morning Munchen [not the starting one]
posted: 2 A Vergence in the Force
posted: 2 Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner [Tatooine Version]
shields: A Tragedy Has Occurred (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)
Don't Do That Again (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)
shields_note: Posted in brackets under An Unusual Amount Of Fear in the starting section: Only Jedi Carry That Weapon, A Tragedy Has Occurred, Don't Do That Again, Planetary Defenses. The strategy says he plays Don't Do That Again, A Tragedy Has Occurred and Only Jedi Carry That Weapon (preferring OJCTW over Planetary Defenses).
notes: Built for an Episode I-only tournament: the post says it was built 'before the Episode 1 tournament today' and is for the 'EP1 tournament'; he won both games with it and James Leiser won once with it. Format left as set; flagged for Bill.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting Jank [7]': Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, An Unusual Amount Of Fear, Podrace Prep, Anakin's Podracer, Brisky Morning Munchen; all counted in the 60.

The four bracketed Defensive Shields under An Unusual Amount Of Fear are outside the 60; A Tragedy Has Occurred and Don't Do That Again dested the Reflections III Defensive Shield printings, not the Coruscant/Tatooine Effects.

Posted 'Sense' and '3 Alter' (under 'SAC') dested the Coruscant Lost Interrupt printings, Sense (Light) (Coruscant) and Alter (Light) (Coruscant), since the deck was built for an Episode I-only event.

Posted '2 Naked Threepio' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing (Tatooine); 'Qui-Gon Jinn [Tatooine Version]' dested Qui-Gon Jinn (Tatooine); 'Qui-Gon's Saber [Tatooine Version]' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber; 'Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner [Tatooine Version]' dested Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner (Tatooine).
Posted 'Coruscant Jedi Council' dested Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber; 'Jar Jar's Electrople' dested Jar Jar's Electropole; 'A Step Backwards' dested A Step Backward; 'I did it' dested I Did It!.
Gimme A Lift! is a Theed Palace card (released 12 December 2001), though the post is dated 17 November 2001. Kept as posted.
The post's running 'Total N' lines and section headers are not cards.
